title: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
summary_raw: Google Research built an AI that spots signs of high blood pressure using only the pulse and motion sensors in a standard smartwatch, no cuff needed. In a 196-person study, its 65.8 percent detection rate beat the traditional in-office measurement. The method is already live in the Google Health app, though it doesn't replace a formal diagnosis. summary_raw: OpenAI is talking about the AGI era, and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says AGI has arrived. They're betting that the current recipe alone won't be enough. title: METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July
summary_raw: Nonprofit METR spent eleven weeks auditing Anthropic's internal research data and concluded that the pace of model development has roughly doubled, with about 80 percent of the speedup driven by AI-assisted research. Anthropic redacted the most informative evidence, though, which means the public has to rely on METR's judgment "much more than would be ideal." There are also skeptical voices inside the company.
